pages.text: Julia sits Toby down on the grass. "Floating is like feelings," she said.
pages.picture: girl sitting the dragon down like a teacher

pages.text: Toby thinks. "When I am sad, things lift up a bit. They drift and bob."
pages.picture: small things drifting gently, low to the ground

pages.text: "When I am cross, things zoom up high, quick as a flash. Then they crash down."
pages.picture: things shooting up fast and high

pages.text: "And when you are glad?" asked Julia. "Then not a thing floats," said Toby. "And I do not smash things."
pages.picture: the dragon smiling, everything still on the ground

pages.text: Julia grins. "Let's see!" She sets a frog on Toby's nose.
pages.picture: the girl placing a frog on the dragon's nose

pages.text: "Yikes!" said Toby. He is not glad now. The frog zooms up into a tree!
pages.picture: a frog flying up into a tree, the dragon startled

pages.text: "No, no," said Julia. "Not cross. Just a bit sad. Sad floats are soft."
Toby sighs. Julia waits. Not a thing floats.
pages.picture: the two sitting quietly on the grass
